title: Chapter 1 — Section 11
summary: 11. Now the place where Joshua pitched his camp was called Gilgal, which denotes liberty ; I agree here with Dr. Bernard, and approve of Josephus's interpretation of Gilgal for liberty. See Joshua 5:9

inlines.v: 11. Now the place where Joshua pitched his camp was called Gilgal, which denotes liberty ; I agree here with Dr. Bernard, and approve of Josephus's interpretation of Gilgal for liberty. See Joshua 5:9. for since now they had passed over Jordan, they looked on themselves as freed from the miseries which they had undergone from the Egyptians, and in the wilderness.
